title: autobuy.triggered
description: Published by the ledger when a client's auto-buy rule bought tokens (data model §5's Events table, task 3.6), inside the token hold that needed them and in the same transaction. reason is below_level (the hold would have left fewer tokens than the rule's level) or cover_hold (the hold couldn't have been placed without the purchase). The purchase also publishes tokens.purchased. This is the envelope's data field, not the whole envelope (see platform/events.Envelope).
